description: Source code implementing Bluetooth Hearing Access Service (HAS) with GATT characteristics, preset management, notifications, and client handling for Zephyr RTOS.

classes.name: has_preset
classes.description: Represents a preset with index, properties, name, and operations.

classes.name: client_context
classes.description: Stores client-specific data including address, notification flags, and last known preset index.

classes.name: has_client
classes.description: Represents a connected client with associated connection, context, and notification work.

methods.name: preset_found
methods.description: Finds a preset in the list matching a given preset.

methods.name: preset_insert
methods.description: Inserts a preset into the sorted preset list based on index.

methods.name: preset_alloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new preset with given parameters.

methods.name: preset_free
methods.description: Frees a preset and returns it to the free list.

methods.name: preset_lookup_index
methods.description: Finds a preset by its index.

methods.name: preset_get_head
methods.description: Returns the first preset in the list.

methods.name: preset_get_tail
methods.description: Returns the last preset in the list.

methods.name: preset_get_prev
methods.description: Returns the previous preset in the list.

methods.name: preset_get_next
methods.description: Returns the next preset in the list.

methods.name: update_last_preset_index_known
methods.description: Updates the last known preset index for a client or all clients.

methods.name: set_preset_name
methods.description: Sets the name of a preset at a given index.

methods.name: bt_has_cp_read_preset_rsp
methods.description: Sends a read preset response over GATT.

methods.name: control_point_ntf_complete
methods.description: Callback for completion of control point notification.

methods.name: control_point_ind_complete
methods.description: Callback for completion of control point indication.

methods.name: control_point_send
methods.description: Sends a control point message via GATT notify or indicate.

methods.name: bt_has_cp_generic_update
methods.description: Sends a generic update message for presets.

methods.name: bt_has_preset_register
methods.description: Registers a new preset with specified parameters.

methods.name: bt_has_preset_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a preset by index.

methods.name: set_preset_availability
methods.description: Sets a preset's availability status.

methods.name: bt_has_preset_active_set
methods.description: Sets a preset as active.

methods.name: bt_has_preset_active_get
methods.description: Gets the currently active preset index.

methods.name: bt_has_preset_name_change
methods.description: Changes the name of a preset.
